query: I have lived in Finland on a continuous A-permit for 6 years. I don't have YKI-test results yet. Can I apply for Finnish citizenship now?
expected_answer: No. Under the Citizenship Act amendments that entered into force on 1 October 2024, the general continuous residence period required for acquiring Finnish citizenship is 8 years. Since you have not yet met the language skills requirement (YKI test), you must wait until you have completed 8 years of continuous legal residence before you can apply.

query: I have lived in Finland on a continuous A-permit for 5 years, and I just passed my YKI language test with a B1 level in Finnish. Am I eligible to apply for citizenship?
expected_answer: Yes. If you meet the language skills requirement (demonstrating a satisfactory level of Finnish or Swedish, which is equivalent to CEFR level B1 or YKI test level 3), your required period of continuous residence is reduced to 5 years. Since you have reached 5 years of legal residency and have your YKI certificate, you meet this requirement.

query: I want to apply for citizenship next month. However, I have been on unemployment benefits for 5 months in total over the last 2 years. Will this impact my application?
expected_answer: Yes. Under the Citizenship Act amendments that entered into force on 17 December 2025, you must meet strict conditions for sufficient financial resources. Your resources are not considered sufficient if you have resorted to unemployment benefits or social assistance (toimeentulotuki) for longer than 3 months in total during the past 2 years. Having 5 months of unemployment benefits will likely disqualify you unless an exception applies.

query: I have lived in Finland for 5 years and have my YKI certificate. However, I spent 100 days traveling outside Finland during the last year. Does this affect my citizenship eligibility?
expected_answer: Yes. Under the rules that took effect on 1 October 2024, you can spend a total of 365 days abroad during your entire required period of residence (5 years with language skills). However, of those days, you are allowed to spend no more than 90 days abroad during the single year immediately preceding the citizenship decision. Spending 100 days abroad in the past year exceeds this limit and may delay your eligibility.

query: I am married to a Finnish citizen and we have lived together for 3 years. I have been in Finland for 5 years total and have passed my YKI test. Do I qualify for the shorter citizenship timeline?
expected_answer: Yes. If your spouse is a Finnish citizen and you have lived together in Finland for at least 3 years, the required continuous residence period for citizenship is reduced from 8 years to 5 years. Since you have 5 years of residence and meet the language requirements, you satisfy this timeline.

query: Can I apply for Finnish citizenship for my 10-year-old child at the same time as my own application?
expected_answer: Yes. You can apply for citizenship for your child as a co-applicant at the same time as you submit your own application, provided the child is under 18 years of age and you have sole or joint legal custody of them. The co-applicant child must also be residing in Finland.
